title: Keep source identity available for large unstaged changes on Windows
outcome: Pass Git-selected unstaged paths without requiring a Windows process command line that exceeds its length limit.
acceptance: A Windows checkout whose reported unstaged path list exceeds the process argument limit still yields a complete source_id when its Git diff is within the supported output budget.
The solution keeps Git as the path selector and preserves one shared source identity, stable ordering, path confinement, the caller deadline and output limits.
